title: Mrn value object: equals, hashCode and compareTo
contract: Mrn equality and ordering use the normalized value (trimmed, upper-cased with Locale.ROOT). equals is reflexive, symmetric, false for null and for other types, and consistent with hashCode. Natural ordering is String.compareTo on the normalized value, so it is lexical and not numeric. countDistinct and sortedDistinct treat a null collection as empty and ignore null elements. The Mrn constructor rejects a null raw value with IllegalArgumentException.
notShownInJavadoc: hashCode equals the normalized String hashCode
